sources.version: API v2.10.3; inputs MERRA2, SYN1DEG, POWER
sources.resolution: Native resolution of its inputs (about 0.5° x 0.625° for MERRA-2 meteorology, 1° for SYN1deg solar): one grid cell covers far more than one field
sources.license: NASA open data. Acknowledgement requested: "These data were obtained from the NASA Langley Research Center POWER Project funded through the NASA Earth Science Directorate Applied Science Program."
sources.variables: T2M_MAX (C), T2M_MIN (C), T2M (C), PRECTOTCORR (mm/day), ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN (MJ/m^2/day), WS2M (m/s), RH2M (%), GWETROOT (1), GWETTOP (1)
sources.role: Weekly frost, extreme-heat and heavy-rain frequency; monthly rain, temperature and reference evapotranspiration (FAO-56); root-zone soil wetness now; dry-year check (2023).
sources.limits: Model and satellite-based reanalysis, not a weather station on the field. Root-zone wetness (GWETROOT) is a model output, 0 = dry, 1 = saturated, not volumetric moisture.
